title: Strict evaluation order
requirement: WHEN an expression has multiple evaluated operands or fields, the interpreter SHALL evaluate them once each from left to right.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Nested arguments
scenarios.then: The trace finishes double(2) before starting increment(3), returning 8.

expected.order: left operand's first runtime failure is reported before the right operand is evaluated, and vice versa

unasserted: literal trace event order (the CLI does not retain events)

checks.label: add(double(2),increment(3))

cases.label: left depth failure first
left underflow first
